title: Backup truncate and update entrypoint

scope.rationale: The typed backup owner now exposes the source no-growth truncation helper and nullable public update forwarding entrypoint.

dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete leaf responsibilities are represented; the in-memory Btree image supplies an already-known file size.

inputs: Mutable destination image and target size
Nullable backup, page number, and page bytes
outputs: Non-null backup forwarded to update owner
contracts.ownership: Borrows image and backup; retains backing capacity like source truncation retains file ownership.
contracts.state_and_results: Never extends an image and treats a null backup as a no-op.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Typed image truncation performs no raw I/O; update inherits caller locking invariants.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No allocation; update records failures through the backup owner.

representation_differences: The typed in-memory backup Btree exposes image length directly instead of issuing xFileSize before xTruncate.

oracle.protocol: Exercise smaller/equal/larger target sizes and null/non-null update owners through backup tests.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Typed owner has no direct I/O; source mutex remains a caller invariant.
assurance.malformed_input: Page update inherits backupOnePage bounds and state checks.
assurance.continuation: No-op truncation and null update leave state unchanged.
assurance.performance: Constant-time forwarding or list length change.

integration.native_call_path: backup completion/update notification -> truncate or update forwarding

known_blockers: Focused native trace and full public backup integration.

implementation_spans: Adjacent backup update and completion paths
callees: Typed image shrink and backup update
upstream_tests: Project backup and broad runtime tests
